text: Alliance Leadership Working Groups Working Groups Where members collaborate to accelerate CHERI adoption and help make it successful. Working groups bring together experts from across the CHERI ecosystem to share knowledge, solve common challenges, advance technology and standards, and support real-world deployment. Many of the most important conversations in the CHERI ecosystem happen within working groups. Members can learn from peers, influence future directions, and stay close to emerging developments. For many organisations, working groups are a key reason to join the Alliance. Technical working groups Groups covering languages, operating systems, emulation, hardware integration, safety, and portability across CHERI platforms. Technical ©️ CHERI C/C++ WG Coordinating portable C and C++ support for CHERI platforms. Language and ABI behaviour · Compiler and toolchain experience · Portability and standards View working group Technical ⬛️ CHERI in SoC WG Brings together the architecture, integration, and verification questions involved in adding CHERI to a system-on-chip. SoC architecture and integration · CHERI feature profiles · Hardware and software interfaces View working group Technical 🐧 CHERI Linux WG Coordinates priorities, cross-architecture requirements, implementation experience, and contribution routes for CHERI support in Linux. Linux roadmap and priorities · Cross-architecture interfaces · Upstream contribution View working group Technical 🐦 CHERI QEMU WG Coordinates CHERI support in QEMU so developers have maintained, testable emulation aligned with current architectures and platforms. Architecture and platform models · Maintenance and version alignment · Testing and continuous integration View working group Technical 🤖 CHERI Virtual Machines WG Examines how language runtimes, managed environments, and virtual machines can use and preserve CHERI capabilities. Language runtimes · Managed memory and native interfaces · Capability-aware VM design View working group Technical ⚙️ Rust + CHERI WG Combining memory-safe software and hardware-enforced protection. Rust targets and toolchains · Native interfaces and unsafe code · Platform and runtime support View working group Technical 📋 CHERI + Safety WG Explores how CHERI mechanisms, implementation evidence, and system integration relate to functional safety and assurance needs. Safety requirements and claims · Implementation evidence · Integration and assurance View working group Technical 4️⃣ CHERI for seL4 WG Coordinates work at the intersection of CHERI capabilities, seL4, Microkit, verified kernels, and capability-oriented system design. seL4 and Microkit integration · Capability-oriented interfaces · Isolation and assurance View working group Technical 🆓 CHERI FreeRTOS WG Coordinates common approaches to memory protection, compartmentalisation, interfaces, and platform support for FreeRTOS on CHERI systems. FreeRTOS platform support · Compartments and interfaces · Embedded testing and portability View working group Technical 🪁 CHERI Zephyr WG Coordinates CHERI support for Zephyr across architecture ports, kernel and user interfaces, drivers, tooling, and supported platforms. Zephyr architecture support · Memory protection and compartments · Drivers, tooling, and platforms View working group Technical 👮 MMU-less Systems WG Examines CHERI protection and compartmentalisation for systems that share an address space and do not depend on a conventional memory-management unit. Shared-address-space systems · Embedded compartment models · Resource and real-time constraints View working group Technical 🛠️ OS Support & Portability WG Connects operating-system ports, shared interfaces, terminology, and documentation across CHERI architectures and software projects. Cross-OS interfaces · Portability and terminology · Documentation and integration View working group Programme and ecosystem groups Groups supporting certification, shared repositories, accurate communication, and wider community participation. Programme and ecosystem ✅ Certification WG Develops shared thinking around certification criteria, assurance needs, evidence, and the operation of Alliance certification programmes. Certification criteria · Evidence and assurance needs · Programme development View working group Programme and ecosystem 📣 Marketing WG Coordinates accurate CHERI messaging, shared material, campaigns, events, and communication across the Alliance ecosystem. Shared messaging and material · Campaigns and events · Ecosystem communication View working group Programme and ecosystem 🪪 Promotion & Ambassador Program WG Helping the CHERI ecosystem communicate clearly, consistently, and effectively. Ambassador participation · Talks, demonstrations, and events · Community connections View working group Programme and ecosystem 💾 Repository Management WG Develops consistent practices for the structure, maintenance, contribution, quality, and stewardship of shared Alliance repositories and technical collateral. Repository structure and ownership · Contribution and maintenance · Quality and long-term stewardship View working group Participation Working groups provide a forum to discuss requirements, share implementation experience, review proposals, coordinate projects, and develop practical guidance. Some activities are member-only, while many repositories, publications, and technical outputs are developed within working groups before being released publicly. Finding the right group Working groups evolve as the ecosystem grows, and new groups may be created to address emerging needs. Visit the contact page if you would like help finding the most relevant group or learning how to participate.
